description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Soother] to the user

description.name: Awoken Soother
description.text: White Magic and Bard abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for White Magic and Bard abilities, grants [Stoneskin: 10%]/[Stoneskin: 15%]/[Stoneskin: 20%]/[Stoneskin: 25%]/[Stoneskin: 30%] after using White Magic or Bard abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Stoneskin: 10%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 10% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Stoneskin: 15%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 15% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Stoneskin: 30%

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
